path: Memory panel → AIService.forgetMemory → Brain.forgetMemory → PatternMemory.remove + CognitionRuntime.forgetMemory + ProjectStore.forgetText
no_new_subsystem: the panel calls the authoritative Brain path; nothing about storage, scoping or authorization changed

representations.verified: unit + browser: after a full reload the panel search finds nothing and recall returns none

representations.representation: project checkpoint summary / completed / pending / blockers / nextAction (re-injected by CognitiveContext as “## PROJECT CHECKPOINTS”)
representations.deleted_by: NEW: ProjectStore.forgetText, called by Brain.forgetMemory with the deleted memory's own sentences; AND an answered turn no longer writes a checkpoint at all
representations.verified: unit: deleting a memory drops the checkpoint that quotes it and leaves an unrelated checkpoint intact; browser: the post-fix request contains no checkpoint for the deleted statement

representations.deleted_by: only deleting the conversation does (Brain.forgetConversation + store.remove)
representations.why: the user deleted a memory, not the chat; the message they typed is still their own history. The provider payload may therefore still contain the phrase inside this conversation's own history — that is transcript, not memory, and the evidence separates the two by parsing the request.

representations.deleted_by: nothing to delete — it is rebuilt from the authorized recall on every turn; there is no cached synthesis
representations.verified: code audit (no cache in MemorySynthesizer/PatternMemory recall) + post-reload “Checked memory — nothing related”

representations.deleted_by: n/a — not persisted; recomputed each turn
representations.verified: code audit: ReflectionEngine has no persistence

representations.deleted_by: rebuilt on the next turn from the cleaned stores
representations.verified: browser: 0 occurrences of the deleted phrase in 2 requests after deletion and 2 more after reload

scoping.single_memory: one id; PatternMemory.remove, graph purge by memoryId, observations by memoryId, checkpoints by quoted text
scoping.whole_conversation: unchanged: Brain.forgetConversation (session memories, observations, graph nodes; durable facts survive with origin)
scoping.unrelated_records: untouched — the unit test asserts a neighbouring checkpoint still says “Ship the pricing page by Friday.” and the browser run left 26 other memories in place

provenance.unrelated: kept: no purge touches a record that does not quote the deleted text
provenance.deleted: the trace entry records removed/nodesRemoved/checkpointsChanged, so the deletion itself is auditable
